text_block_list.text: What is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

The 2,000m middle-distance stage battling 
for the Autumn Shield. A momentous day in 
the history of Japanese Umamusume.

A victory here will bestow both honor and 
glory into your hands.

A place where brilliant talents clash. The 
pinnacle I want to reach.
—That is my understanding, yes.
"CASE: Forensics"

As autumn gradually deepened, the ones who 
ignited the biggest spark were those 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
On the world's grandest stage, the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, Orfevre finishes in 2nd 
place!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A truly heartbreaking result! But someday! 
Someday, this Umamusume will reach the top 
of the world! It was a race that truly 
made us believe that!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This regret will turn into future joy! Let 
us believe in our strongest!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, not even this store has it~!? My 
Orfevre special feature issue~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, everyone's gonna buy it. Even the 
morning news was wall-to-wall Orfevre...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, are there any 
magazines left about that race? You know, 
speaking of the Classics around this time 
of year—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The one to conquer the Kikuka Sho, the 
final stop on the Classic Triple Crown 
road, is none other than the mischievous 
Umamusume—Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With an "unprecedented" long spurt, she 
completely stunned the crowd!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Man, Gold Ship really is hilarious! 
Honestly, Golshi's gotta be the best of 
this generation!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe," "Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe," "Kikka Sho"... 
Orfe-san, Orfe-san, Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The article about the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...'A chaotic struggle with no clear 
frontrunner.'

Heading to the library to gather data, I 
find someone already there.
choice_data_list: Is that from this month's issue?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Yes, it's the latest issue. It looks 
like the lineup for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
is summarized as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Would you like to take a look?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I still have much to learn.
choice_data_list: Huh, what's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I was reflecting on my own immaturity. I 
grew conceited, thinking I was someone 
worthy of attention.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I'm just a Classic-tier 
challenger who doesn't carry the banner of 
a front-runner.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If not for Golshi-san bringing it up, 
fewer and fewer people would even touch 
upon it."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ... —However!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even for someone like me with little 
attention and a class disadvantage, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) is a course well-suited 
to my strengths!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The experience from this race will surely 
make me even stronger and tougher!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (—Calm down, Fenomeno.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I stand in the paddock by my own will.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Closing one's eyes is no different from 
refusing to face who stands before you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you desire victory, you should gather 
information down to the smallest detail.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Me too! I set a record at last 
year's Tenno Sho (Autumn), you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em what a truly big run looks 
like.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Eishin Flash, Tosen Jordan...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh! Watch out, Fenomeno!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Today's opponents are seasoned veterans 
who have survived countless fierce 
battles.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (—Focus solely on my running!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Two minutes have passed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"There are 15 minutes left until you enter 
the track. Will you be mentally prepared 
in time?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...Yes...!! It's not a problem at 
all...!

And the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—a clash between 
Classic and Senior classes—got underway—!
